blocking_findings.summary: t-eos-c15: Grounded turns and focus are CLEARED when the attested statement identity changes - scope, pins or block - while ordinary Ask turns are preserved. AskProvider outlives the route, so without this an explanation of a July DUB figure stays in the dock after a different statement is generated and reads as though it describes the new numbers.

non_blocking_findings.summary: [P2] Clear stale drill and grounded turns when the statement disappears (frontend/src/features/mis/mis-report-view.tsx:59): When a subsequent Generate resolves to `unresolvable` or `refresh-required`, `identity` becomes undefined and this early return skips every cleanup action.
